Airframe #1 · As-built assembly

TBS Source One V5.1 · MicoAir NxtPX4v2 / 50A ESC · ArmSoM CM5 + IO. As-built placement, real printed STLs, simplified electronics and fasteners.

As-built visual preview (2026-11-21). The FC is rigidly attached to the 38 × 38 mm printed adapter above the ESC. Silicone washers are present, but vibration isolation is not validated. Compute BEC is not installed. External hardware is schematic; printed components use the supplied actual STL files.
